title: Maßnahmenkatalog der Österreichischen Strategie für Cybersicherheit 2021: Fortschrittsbericht 1/2025
summary: Progress report 1/2025 on the measures catalogue of the Austrian Cyber Security Strategy 2021, published by the Federal Chancellery. It tracks project 2073, an AIT project on post-quantum-computer-secure encryption running from 1 January 2021 to 31 December 2026, reported with green status at 70 per cent progress.

title: Österreichischer Forschungs- und Technologiebericht 2025
summary: Austria's federal research and technology report for 2025, published by the science, infrastructure and economy ministries and laid before Parliament (III-177 der Beilagen, XXVIII. GP). Its profile of the Austrian Institute of Technology (AIT) lists quantum communication, in particular quantum key distribution including post-quantum cryptography methods, among AIT's research priorities.

title: AUTKRYPTO: Kryptosystem Made-in-Austria
summary: FFG project record for AUTKRYPTO, a KIRAS cooperative R&D project (October 2024 to March 2027) to build an Austrian encryption device, including a demonstrator hardware platform implementing a post-quantum secure VPN with an FPGA/software co-design architecture.
